LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_ImperialGreatsword.label: [Raven] Imperial Greatsword
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_ImperialGreatsword.descript: A two-handed greatsword used by the Raven Fusang imperial guard. Its heavy blade shatters defenses with overwhelming force, and a solid hit is enough to briefly knock an enemy off balance.
